summary: Iteration 108 — backend-only regression for lint-driven upload+storage refactors: 20/20 pytest PASS. Verified request/response contracts for every touched endpoint. NO regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/advertiser.py:387 — the tigris upload is gated on `st.backend_name == 'tigris'`, but the other 4 upload routes (ad3_sponsorships, ad11_banners, ad12_notifications, flagship_stations, admin/tracks/upload) call `_get_storage().upload_bytes(...)` UNCONDITIONALLY (wrapped in try/except). That means on the local backend (default) they now write the same bytes twice: once to /app/backend/static/... and once to /app/backend/storage/... (via LocalDiskStorage.upload_bytes → upload → shutil.copyfile). Behavior is correct but doubles disk I/O in dev. Consider mirroring advertiser.py's `if st.backend_name == 'tigris'` guard everywhere, OR make LocalDiskStorage.upload_bytes a no-op (cheap fallback).

backend/services/object_storage.py:79-90 — upload_bytes spools to a tempfile for EVERY backend even Local, when the Local backend could just write the bytes directly. Minor perf nit for the LocalDiskStorage fast path (double-copy: tempfile → shutil.copyfile → dst). Override upload_bytes on LocalDiskStorage to `dst.parent.mkdir(...); dst.write_bytes(data)` to save one filesystem round-trip.

backend/server.py:2610-2620 — comment still says 'Phase 22e — stream to disk + hash chunk-by-chunk so a 100 MB upload doesn't materialize into process RAM.' but the code now does `data = await file.read()` (full-bytes into RAM). Update the comment (or restore chunked streaming + a separate `upload_bytes` for durability). At 100 MB per upload with concurrent admins this can be a real memory pressure regression, but for the current admin-only single-upload flow it's fine.

backend/routes/marketplace_orders.py:325 — `profile: {k:v for k,v in profile.items() if k != '_id'}` is correct, but the same dict-strip pattern is repeated inline. Consider a tiny helper `_strip_mongo_id(d)` shared with _clean() on line 47 to keep intent DRY.

backend/routes/advertiser.py:398 — silent `logger.warning` on tigris upload failure is fine, but the equivalent try/except blocks in ad3/ad11/ad12/flagship_stations use bare `except Exception: pass` — no log line. If prod storage is misconfigured we'd never know. Add `logger.warning('[upload_bytes] durable persist failed: %s', e)` in all four locations.

rca of the issue: Not applicable — no regressions found. The lint-driven refactor is confirmed behavior-preserving: (a) object_storage.upload_bytes() is a new abstraction method that spools bytes to tempfile → delegates to upload(). (b) All 5 upload routes call it in try/except; local backend still writes to /app/backend/static/... (the primary user-visible path via /api/static/...) and additionally shadows to /app/backend/storage/... (durable cache). (c) admin/tracks/upload switched from chunk-streaming to `data = await file.read()` — memory-heavy for very large mp3s but functionally identical. (d) marketplace_orders._price_menu now returns profile with _id excluded — verified via /quote (profile popped) and by scanning the full quote body for _id keys — none found.
